scope: all 36 pinned TRAIN parquet shards from a third-party DocVQA repack; source equivalence remains unverified; no student training
exclude_all_eval: all evaluation images and existing cross-task groups, regardless of DEV/CONFIRM/FINAL
edges: same original UCSF document and one-based page
pHash Hamming distance <= 4 across TRAIN and evaluation images
transitive_rule: union all TRAIN and existing eval groups across all edges; exclude every entire connected component containing any evaluation image
page_semantics: evaluation filename _pN is original page N+1; bound by eval_path_semantics_001.json across 5349 projected rows
image_fingerprint: reuse frozen data_manifest/build.py describe() in Pillow 11.2.1/SciPy 1.15.2; preserve hashes and original image dimensions
near_candidate_enumeration: five bit partitions (13,13,13,13,12), check XOR bit_count <=4, as existing eval grouping; no approximate index misses under this threshold
eligible_group_identifier: SHA256 UTF-8 group| followed by sorted member byte-SHA256 joined with |; no dependence on question, answer or model output
fit_validation: sort eligible TRAIN groups by SHA256(20261105|TRAIN_FIT_VAL|group_id), tie group_id; first floor(0.8*n) fit, remaining early-stop-validation; split applies to every question in group
question_selection_if_needed: before accessing labels or training, choose one question per group by SHA256(20261105|TRAIN_QID|qid), ties numeric/string qid; any later training subset must be frozen separately
proof_requirements: 36 downloaded shards with SHA256 and completion/exit evidence
evaluation fingerprints, semantic mapping and source versions unchanged
every TRAIN row and question ID accounted for; no evaluation-connected group in eligible list
each group belongs to exactly one fit or validation split
independent implementation and synthetic transitive/cross-split counterexamples
third-party provenance scope and all unverified aspects explicitly retained
limitations: pHash threshold may miss re-renders or semantic duplicates; no mathematical guarantee of complete decontamination
No reference answer, question text, prediction, model or GPU is needed by this audit
A training plan, teacher budget, train labels and student validation must be fixed separately; no training is authorized by this audit alone
